 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification
 LIVE: Sudan vs Senegal | AFCON 2027 Qualifiers
 Sudan and Senegal meet again on Monday, November 16, in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers. After the Lions of Teranga secured a convincing 4-1 victory in Dakar, Sudan will look to bounce back and revive its qualification hopes in Group J.
 Watch Sudan vs Senegal LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 Sudan vs Senegal: How and Where to Watch LIVE 
 Matchday 4 of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers brings an important encounter to Juba National Stadium in South Sudan , where Sudan will officially host Senegal on Monday, November 16.
 The Lions of Teranga lead Group J with seven points from three matches, while Sudan has collected three points and needs a positive result to remain competitive.
 Kickoff is scheduled for 8:00 AM ET / 5:00 AM PT , with coverage beginning at 7:50 AM ET / 4:50 AM PT on beIN SPORTS CONNECT in the United States.
 Sudan Looks to Recover After Heavy Defeat in Dakar 
 Sudan , managed by Kwesi Appiah , has experienced a challenging qualifying campaign, recording one victory and two defeats.
 The Falcons of Jediane opened with a 1-0 victory over Ethiopia on September 25, thanks to a late penalty from Mohamed Eisa .
 However, Sudan subsequently suffered a 4-1 defeat against Mozambique , with Yasin Hamed scoring its only goal.
 Their latest encounter ended in another 4-1 defeat against Senegal on November 12. Mohamed Abuaagla equalized shortly before halftime, but the Sudanese side conceded three unanswered second-half goals.
 With eight goals conceded in three matches, defensive improvement will be essential for Appiah's team.
 The squad includes Mohamed Eisa , Yasir Mozamil , Mustafa Karshoum and goalkeeper Mohamed Mustafa .
 Senegal Aims to Extend Its Unbeaten Run Under Patrick Vieira 
 Senegal , coached by Patrick Vieira , leads Group J after collecting two victories and one draw.
 The Lions of Teranga began with a 1-1 draw against Mozambique , followed by a 1-0 victory over Ethiopia .
 Their most recent performance was particularly impressive, as Senegal defeated Sudan 4-1 in Dakar.
 Nicolas Jackson opened the scoring in the 31st minute before Boulaye Dia , Ibrahim Mbaye and Pathé Mboup completed the victory.
 Vieira continues to reshape the national team, with Sadio Mané and Idrissa Gana Gueye absent from the November squad.
 Nevertheless, Kalidou Koulibaly , Jackson , Iliman Ndiaye and Lamine Camara provide experience and quality throughout the team.
 A Crucial Encounter in the Race for Group J Qualification 
 Senegal leads Group J with seven points, followed by Mozambique with four. Sudan and Ethiopia have three points each after the opening three rounds.
 The top two teams will qualify for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations , hosted by Kenya , Tanzania and Uganda .
 Senegal could take another significant step toward qualification with a victory, while Sudan needs points to close the gap on its direct rivals.
 The match will take place in Juba, South Sudan, which serves as Sudan's designated home venue during the qualifying campaign.
